description: Turns the streams from up to five 8GT or 8CV Encoders into the stereo pair an ES-4 or ES-40 expander decodes

inputs.text: Carries the encoded stream from an 8GT Encoder or 8CV Encoder to the ES-4(0) expansion header of the same number; the voltage is truncated to a whole number and clamped to 0 and 255
Carries the encoded stream for the fifth ES-4(0) expansion header; its top four bits go into the left output word and its bottom four into the right, so it gives four bits to each channel

outputs.text: The left channel of the encoded pair, built from the first two inputs and the top half of the fifth; patch it to one side of the S/PDIF output driving the ES-4(0)
The right channel of the encoded pair, built from the third and fourth inputs and the bottom half of the fifth; patch it to the other side of that output

notes: Each input corresponds to one expansion header on the physical ES-4(0), and the two outputs go to the S/PDIF output of the audio interface, which is what drives it.
Nothing reaches the hardware until an 8GT Encoder or 8CV Encoder is patched into an input.
